legacyWorkstreams.objective: Users remain authenticated while refresh tokens rotate safely.

legacyWorkstreams.title: Checkout redesign
legacyWorkstreams.objective: A faster, accessible checkout that matches the new brand and keeps conversion tracking intact.

legacyWorkstreams.title: Distributed tracing
legacyWorkstreams.objective: Every public API request produces a trace that spans api, auth-service and payments.

legacyWorkstreams.title: Rotate JWT signing keys
legacyWorkstreams.objective: Signing keys rotate automatically every 90 days with zero downtime.

legacyWorkstreams.title: Migrate CI runners to ARM
legacyWorkstreams.objective: All CI pipelines run on ARM runners at 30% lower cost.

legacyWorkstreams.title: Checkout rewrite
legacyWorkstreams.objective: Replace the legacy checkout with a server-driven flow owned jointly by Payments, Identity, Web and Infra.

legacyWorkstreams.title: Saved payment methods migration
legacyWorkstreams.objective: Migrate stored cards to network tokens without re-entering details.

legacyWorkstreams.title: Dependency vulnerability sweep
legacyWorkstreams.objective: No critical or high CVEs in production dependencies, with an enforced remediation SLA.

legacyWorkstreams.title: Audit log retention policy
legacyWorkstreams.objective: Define and implement how long audit logs are kept, and where.

legacyWorkstreams.title: Rate limiting for the public API
legacyWorkstreams.objective: Protect the public API with per-key rate limits and clear 429 responses.

legacyWorkstreams.title: Webhook retries with backoff
legacyWorkstreams.objective: Outgoing webhooks retry with exponential backoff and never deliver duplicates.

legacyWorkstreams.title: Design system tokens migration
legacyWorkstreams.objective: All components consume semantic design tokens so theming (light, dark, brand) is a config change.

legacyWorkstreams.title: GraphQL gateway spike
legacyWorkstreams.objective: Evaluate whether a GraphQL gateway in front of the public API is worth the operational cost.

legacyWorkstreams.objective: Export historical invoices to CSV for finance.

issues.title: Users occasionally get redirected back to login
issues.body: Several customers report being logged out after a few hours of normal use, with no error shown.

issues.title: Session lost after Safari ITP cookie expiry
Refresh endpoint returns 500 under load
issues.body: Seen during the load test on staging: bursts of 500s from /auth/refresh.

issues.title: Coupon field loses focus on mobile
Webhook retries sometimes deliver duplicate events
Elevated 5xx on /v2/orders
issues.body: p99 latency tripled for 40 minutes. Root cause unclear without cross-service traces.

threadRecords.summary: Found the logout loop: two tabs refresh the session at once and the second refresh is treated as a replay. Serialised the refresh per session and added a regression test.

decisions.text: Refresh tokens stay server side; the client never reads them.
Serialise refreshes per session with a short lock instead of retrying on replay.

comments.body: Linking this and AUTH-143 to AUTH-42; same root cause (non-deterministic refresh).
Please rebase on the queue refactor before the next review round.
Collector lint fails because the exporter endpoint is templated in Helm. Fixing the values file.
